text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — customer asks for a Starter-tier 'burst' model that can auto-scale during spikes. My proposal: Starter = 100k tokens/mo baseline + 1M burst credits included; optional 'Surge Pack' add-on that adds 5M burst tokens at a flat monthly fee. Thoughts?

Jordan Lee: Don't call it 'auto-scale' without guardrails. Ops can't guarantee capacity. We need explicit limits and a time window.

Aarav Singh: +1 on windowed bursts. Suggest: bursts are billed/allocated in 24h buckets per project. Easier to enforce and avoids indefinite debt.

Priya Nair: From Sales — prospects want a contract clause for reserved burst during business hours. They asked for a way to buy 'priority burst' that gets routed ahead of normal queued traffic.

Ben (revops): We can't promise reserved capacity on Hosted tiers unless they pay for Dedicated. We could offer a paid priority add-on with SLA. Example pricing sketch: $2k/mo + $0.000012 per token after included burst. Need billing export changes.

Maya Patel: Draft launch criteria I'm thinking: (a) 3 pilot customers validated, (b) billing integrated end-to-end and exportable, (c) console UX for quota and 'request more' flow, (d) legal-approved contract language for Surge Pack, (e) telemetry to track burst usage and cost impact.

Jordan Lee: Gate metrics: P95 latency <250ms during burst windows, cost delta vs baseline <15% for typical workloads, and <1% increase in failure/timeout rate. Otherwise we hold rollout.

Aarav Singh: Tech note — current autoscaler is global and not tenant-reservable. Implementing per-tenant reservation + priority queueing is nontrivial; estimate ~3 sprints for a minimal design (reservation + enforcement).

Priya Nair: Sales: they also want a UI knob in the Contract Editor — 'committed burst tokens' with configurable monthly commitment and a checkbox for priority routing. Can the Console show that?

Ben (revops): Metering changes required. We need a new dimension: `burst_tokens_used` in billing exports and the raw events stream. Example CSV row for exports:
```
customer_id,invoice_period,baseline_tokens,burst_tokens_used,burst_addon_fee,overage_tokens
cust_ABC,2026-03,100000,350000,2000,245000
```
Also need alerts when burst spend exceeds X% of committed.

Maya Patel: Draft contract snippet for Legal to start from: "Surge Pack: provides prioritized access to burst capacity subject to platform availability. In the event of capacity constraints, Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to route priority traffic; credits are pro-rata service credits only. No hard availability guarantee unless Dedicated capacity is purchased." @legal please advise.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-6789 for per-tenant reservation design and linked it to roadmap epic RD-2026. (https://tracker.internal/INF-6789)

Priya Nair: Sales asks whether we can waive setup for pilots and give 50% off first month of Surge Pack to remove friction. They will supply two pilot logos if accepted.

Jordan Lee: If we run pilots, do an A/B enabled rollout: enable Surge Pack for 10% of Starter customers first, monitor cost + perf for 2 weeks before wider launch.

Maya Patel: Action items: (1) @Jordan scope the technical work + rough ETA, (2) @Ben produce billing spec and export sample, (3) @Priya pick 3 pilot customers and draft pilot terms, (4) @Aarav prototype 24h-window enforcement approach. Sync tomorrow 9am PT to confirm gates. :thumbsup:
